    fun testAdminSwitchInvalidatesOldAdminResponsesAndGuardsNewAdminData() = runTest {

        val slowListA = CompletableDeferred<AdminListNotificationCampaignsEnvelope>()
        repo.slowListDeferred = slowListA
        vm.loadHistory()
        assertTrue(vm.uiState.value.isHistoryLoading)

        // Hold Admin A's action
        val slowCreateA = CompletableDeferred<AdminNotificationCampaignMutationResponse>()
        repo.createDeferred = slowCreateA
        vm.onTitleViChange("Tiêu đề của Admin A")
        vm.onTitleEnChange("Title A")

        vm.onBodyEnChange("Body A")
        vm.saveDraft()
        assertTrue("Admin A save is in progress", vm.uiState.value.isActionInProgress)

        // Switch to Admin B
        currentSimulatedUser = "admin-B"
        currentSimulatedGen = 101L
        repo.slowListDeferred = null // Admin B's calls complete immediately
        repo.createDeferred = null

        // Trigger synchronous reconciliation
        vm.reconcileSession()

        val stateB = vm.uiState.value
        assertEquals("admin-B", stateB.currentAdminId)
        assertEquals("Draft title must be cleared on admin switch", "", stateB.draftTitleVi)
        assertFalse("Action guard must be unlocked for Admin B", stateB.isActionInProgress)

        // Admin B loads history and starts their own action
        vm.loadHistory()
        assertEquals("Admin B history loaded", 1, vm.uiState.value.campaigns.size)

        vm.onTitleViChange("Tiêu đề của Admin B")
        vm.onTitleEnChange("Title B")
        vm.onBodyViChange("Nội dung B")
        vm.onBodyEnChange("Body B")

        // Now Admin A's delayed responses finally return
        slowListA.complete(
            AdminListNotificationCampaignsEnvelope(
                items = listOf(createDummyCampaign(titleVi = "Stale List From A")),
                hasMore = false,
                nextCursor = null
            )
        )
        slowCreateA.complete(
            AdminNotificationCampaignMutationResponse(
                success = true,
                campaign = createDummyCampaign(id = "stale-camp-a", titleVi = "Stale Camp A")
            )
        )

        // Verify Admin B's data is 100% intact and was NOT overwritten by Admin A!
        val finalStateB = vm.uiState.value
        assertEquals("admin-B", finalStateB.currentAdminId)
        assertEquals("Admin B's draft title must remain intact", "Tiêu đề của Admin B", finalStateB.draftTitleVi)
        assertFalse("Old response must not mark editing id from A", finalStateB.editingCampaignId == "stale-camp-a")
        assertFalse("Stale list must not overwrite B", finalStateB.campaigns.any { it.titleVi == "Stale List From A" })
    }
